headline: Urja Global releases Q2 financial results
hook: Urja Global reports September quarter financials
summary: Urja Global Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the NSE. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Review the company's profitability and debt levels in the latest filing.
